frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Ramsey-Cass-Koopmans replaces Solow's exogenous saving rate with an infinitely-lived household maximizing discounted CRRA utility; the consumption Euler equation c-dot/c = (r-rho)/theta says consumption rises if the real return exceeds the discount rate, and the steady-state interest rate is pinned by the modified golden rule r* = rho + theta*g.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Ramsey-Cass-Koopmans Optimal Savings
